# S&P 500 + ETF Historical Dataset

Free, reproducible, point-in-time S&P 500 history: who was in the index on
every trading day since **1970**, with a price for every one of them on every
day, plus ETFs. No paid data vendor.

> **Read this first.** Two tiers, checked differently (details in the
> verification log):
> - **1996 to today** — every member priced on every day, every close and
>   dividend cross-checked against CRSP and at least one vendor or archive,
>   membership matched to S&P's own announcements.
> - **1970–1995** — membership from CRSP's own S&P 500 list and prices from
>   CRSP (no free vendor carries the companies that disappeared before
>   1996). Checked against the published S&P 500 (the index rebuilt from
>   these members tracks it within ~3–5 basis points a day), against CRSP's
>   own returns, and against Yahoo for the 174 survivors. No
>   open/high/low/volume.
>
> **Every member-day from 1970 to 2024 is compared with CRSP's daily total
> return** (`tools/full_crsp_check.py`, published as `full_check_*` files).
> Disagreements over 0.5pp go to the published S&P 500's own daily return,
> which decides when the member is big enough. Results:
> - 99.990% of 6,943,082 member-days are within 0.5pp. The 669 that are not are
>   listed in `full_check_flagged.csv`.
> - Where the index can judge, it never sides with CRSP against this data: 12 runs
>   favour ours, and the other 333 are too small or too close to call (mostly

primeras: Tiingo books the Stilwell Financial spin-off as a $181 dividend per POST-split share but omits the 1-for-2 reverse split of the same day. Adding the split makes the record consistent: holders kept ~3.5% of value in KSU and received the rest as Stilwell stock.

R.R. Donnelley spun off LSC Communications and Donnelley Financial and did a 1-for-3 reverse split the same day. Tiingo books the distribution ($25.61 per post-split share) but omits the split; the close moves 15.72 -> 23.81 on that date.
ultimas: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF monthly distribution, ex/record 2026-10-01, paid 2026-10-06 (iShares 2026 distribution schedule; $0.31158 a share per stockanalysis.com). Yahoo carried 0.312 until 2026-11-02 (snapshot-2026-11) and deleted it in the 2026-11-03 pull with every other 10/1 ex-date. Restored at the value Yahoo carried.

The Campbell's Company's $0.25 quarterly dividend (cut from $0.39; $1.00 annualized), declared 2026-09-03, ex-date and record 2026-10-01, payable 2026-11-02 (the company's own dividend history table at investor.thecampbellscompany.com/stock-info/dividends-and-splits; S&P Capital IQ via MarketScreener 2026-09-03). Yahoo carried 0.25 until 2026-11-02 (snapshot-2026-11) and deleted it in the 2026-11-03 pull with every other 10/1 ex-date; CPB left the index 2026-06-22, so the nightly guard did not list it. Restored from the company's own record.

primeras: Yahoo scales AT&T's closes before the WarnerMedia spin-off (2022-04-11) by its 1.324 spin factor but left the dividends as declared ($0.52 a quarter in 2021 against a close of ~$19.9 instead of ~$26.3), so every AT&T dividend yield before April 2022 came out 32% too high (1996-2022 total return 339% instead of 194%). Every other parent's dividends are scaled; checked by verify.py ('dividend basis').
